title: Getting a Social Security number as a noncitizen
rule: If your status allows you to work, apply for an SSN in person at a Social Security office. SSA recommends waiting about 10 days after arriving so it can verify your DHS records online. Bring original documents (passport, I-94, and work authorization such as an I-797 or EAD); photocopies are not accepted. It is free. If you are applying for work authorization from USCIS, you can request the SSN on Form I-765 instead.
notes: The 10-day recommendation comes from SSA publication EN-05-10096, found on 2026-10-24 in archived and university copies; the current version was not read.
